exclude_num_interacted.description: Number of unique recently interacted artworks to be excluded from recommendations

exclude_num_recommended.description: Number of recently recommended artworks to be excluded from recommendations

shuffle_len.description: Length of recommendations to shuffle in image-based recommendation

num_tag.description: Number of unique tags to create recommendations for (number of sub-channels in tag-based recommendation)

tag_log_len.description: Number of unique log entries for calculating tag click rates

default_artist_num.description: Number of artists to recommend by default
